name: Willow

spine.record: A person's employment period with its effective-dated terms, leave ledger and lifecycle evidence

description: People register, effective-dated employment, owner-approved leave policies with an append-only ledger, joiner/mover/leaver cases with evidence, private documents, payroll change handoff, access-scoped summaries and agent proposals, and a BambooHR move-in kit.
nonGoals: Payroll calculation, tax filing or payments
Automated candidate ranking, dismissal recommendations, surveillance or psychological scoring

externals.why: Worker hosting, D1 records and R2 private documents
data: Employee identities and private contact details
Leave balances, requests and confidential reasons

deploy.notes: Native owner and member sessions guard /app and /api/willow; private fields pass through one access projection; unknown paths return real 404s; the development outbox is local-only.
